# sonarqube_qualityprofile (List Resource)

Lists quality profiles.

## Example Usage

```terraform
list "sonarqube_qualityprofile" "java" {
  provider = sonarqube

  config {
    language = "java"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `include_built_in` (Boolean) Include built-in objects, which cannot be managed. Defaults to false.
- `language` (String) Only profiles of this language.
